name: Columnar Run-Length Encoding for Voxel Terrain
definition: A compression technique for voxel terrain where voxels are stored as columns. It compresses homogeneous runs of voxels along the y-axis (vertical) into single entries, reducing memory usage compared to storing every voxel or vertex individually.
summary: Columnar Run-Length Encoding compresses voxel terrain by storing vertical columns as homogeneous runs along the y-axis, reducing memory usage compared to full 3D spatial subdivision methods.
